---
title: "RFC 014: Runtime Dispatch Integration"
subtitle: "CLI Command Construction and Runner Execution"
date: 2026-01-19
---

## Executive Summary

This phase connects dispatch planning to runnable CLI commands. It resolves runtime binaries, builds process commands for task names or task files, and executes them through a pluggable runner so tests can validate behavior without invoking the full pipeline.

## Implementation Scope

| Area | Deliverable | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime CLI resolution | `resolve_runtime_cli` | Finds CLI in runtime `.venv` or bin directory. |
| Command builder | `build_process_command` | Uses task name or `--task-file` automatically. |
| Runner integration | `run_dispatch_plan` | Executes commands via runner or subprocess. |

: Table 1. Runtime dispatch deliverables.

## Appendix A: Behaviors

- CLI resolution checks runtime `.venv` paths first and falls back to runtime bin locations.
- Task file paths take precedence over task name when `.py` files exist.
